title: My Favorite Months
text:
My favorite month is June. It is warm and sunny in June. My birthday is on June 12. We have a picnic in the park on my birthday.

March is a windy month. It has 31 days. In March, the weather is cold in the morning. My sister's birthday is on March 3, and we make a cake at home.

questions.text: What is the narrator's favorite month?
How many days does March have?
How does the narrator probably feel about warm days?
options: The narrator is afraid of them

questions.text: What can we guess about the family on the sister's birthday?
options: They probably celebrate together at home
They probably travel to another country

vocabulary.definition: the one you like the most
a meal eaten outdoors, often in a park
a sweet food made by baking flour, eggs and sugar

paragraph_translations: En sevdiğim ay haziran. Haziranda hava sıcak ve güneşli. Doğum günüm 12 Haziran. Doğum günümde parkta piknik yapıyoruz.
Mart rüzgarlı bir aydır. 31 gün vardır. Martta sabahları hava soğuktur. Kız kardeşimin doğum günü 3 Mart'tır ve evde pasta yaparız.
